description: Use functional components with hooks, not class components
rationale: Hooks are the modern React API and simplify state and lifecycle management

description: Define an explicit Props interface above each component
rationale: Explicit prop types catch bugs at compile time and serve as documentation

description: Apply React.memo only to provably expensive renders, not by default
rationale: Unneeded memoization adds complexity and can slow down cheap components

description: Extract reused hooks into use*.ts files under a hooks directory
rationale: Shared hooks prevent duplication and centralize logic

description: Prefer CSS Modules, Tailwind, or CSS-in-JS over inline style props
rationale: Inline styles bypass caching, fragment styling, and hurt performance
!important breaks the cascade and makes styles hard to override

description: Write mobile-first media queries using min-width
rationale: Mobile-first progressively enhances for larger screens and reduces CSS

description: Use design tokens (variables) instead of hardcoded colors and spacing
rationale: Tokens enable theming and keep visual language consistent

description: Keep initial JS bundle under 500KB and per-component under 50KB
rationale: Large bundles delay interactivity and hurt LCP on slow networks
Core Web Vitals are Google ranking signals and track perceived UX

description: Provide a stable unique key when mapping lists, never array index
rationale: Index keys cause reconciliation bugs when items reorder or are removed

description: Do not mutate the DOM directly — use refs and state
rationale: Direct DOM mutation conflicts with React's virtual DOM and causes drift

description: Use controlled components with state-backed values
rationale: Controlled inputs keep React state as the single source of truth

description: Code-split routes with React.lazy and Suspense
rationale: Route-level splitting shrinks the initial bundle significantly

description: Wrap feature subtrees in error boundaries
rationale: Error boundaries prevent a single error from crashing the whole app
